name: Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol
purpose: Linux Foundation protocol for agent-to-agent discovery, task delegation, and interoperability — the complement to MCP's tool access. Check version compatibility between implementations.

name: A2A protocol (GitHub)
purpose: Specification source, samples, and SDK links for Agent2Agent.

name: AG-UI Protocol
purpose: Event-based protocol connecting agent backends to user interfaces (streaming state, tool calls, human input).

name: CopilotKit
purpose: React framework for agent-native UIs; creators/stewards of AG-UI. Use when the frontend must render agent state, not just chat text.

name: bifrost
purpose: Open-source, high-performance AI gateway that works as your LLM gateway, MCP gateway and agent gateway. One OpenAI-compatible API for 10,000+ models, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys,.

name: unity mcp
purpose: Unity MCP acts as a bridge between AI assistants and your Unity Editor. Give your LLM tools to manage assets, control scenes, edit scripts, and automate tasks within Unity.

name: x64dbg mcp server
purpose: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP.
